blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipino tennis star Alex Eala has been named to TIME’s TIME100 Next 2026 list, which recognizes rising figures shaping the future. Eala is the only tennis player on this year’s list and was selected in the Innovators category. Tennis legend Rafael Nadal, who has known Eala since she joined his academy in 2018 at age 13, wrote about the Filipino’s game, maturity and poise for TIME.
